connector.name: DataClawe - Database as a Utility
connector.registryDescription: AI-native database utility. Talk to your DB in plain language. No SQL. MySQL & PostgreSQL.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.dataclawe.com over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.dataclawe. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: DataClawe access key in Bearer format (e.g. 'Bearer dc_xxxxxxxxxxxx'). Get your access key at dataclawe.com
